set.body: Native owner of plsneuro bd-01M1W0A0Y8AQ34EWPGPYKTM121. FirstLevelUnitDataset currently implicitly uses TR/2; ds000001 TR2 and 300 scans are modeled at 1..599s, although stored volume timestamps start at zero. Add typed finite fraction in [0,1], uniform and exact-identity per-run declarations, resolved run-local sampling receipt, explicit starts passed into native dataset/schema/fit. Preserve midpoint default for source compatibility; no event shifts or inference of slice timing correction. Carry observed SliceTimingCorrected metadata separately from selected reference, rejecting malformed present declarations. Acceptance: shared JVM/JS reference and BIDS metadata tests, public JVM MNI crop boundary fixture distinguishes start versus midpoint event support and independently recovers FIR coefficients, invalid/missing/foreign declarations fail before file IO. Source origin, requested model timing and preprocessing evidence must remain separate. UI adoption is tracked in plsneuro.
set.title: Declare and preserve explicit per-run first-level sampling reference
